content.json:
# Voice performance

Measured in the candidate's browser (App Insights JS SDK) and in the backend (OpenTelemetry). Every number is a duration in **milliseconds**; only timings, ids and outcomes are recorded, never text.

* **voice.setup** — one per voice connection, from opening the WebSocket.
* **voice.avatar** — one per avatar WebRTC handshake (first connect, recovery rebuild, media-mode switch). `stun_srflx_ms` = time to the STUN answer (first server-reflexive candidate), `turn_relay_ms` = time to the TURN allocation (first relay candidate), both from the offer.
* **voice.turn** — one per interviewer response; `kind = answer` turns include the candidate's answer. `click_to_audible_ms` is what the candidate feels: from finishing the answer to hearing the next question.

* **voice.media** — WebRTC quality every 15 s from the browser's `getStats()`: RTT, jitter, loss, audible concealment, jitter buffer, bitrate, fps, freezes.
* **The voice WebSocket** — a `WebSocket` dependency in the browser, parent of the backend's `voice.session` span (same trace).

Metric definitions: `docs/voice-performance-telemetry.md`.

parameters.name: Interview
parameters.label: Interview
parameters.query:
// Interviews with voice telemetry, newest first; the newest is selected by default.
customEvents
| where name startswith "voice." and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.interview_id)) and tostring(customDimensions.interview_id) != "playground"
| summarize last_seen = max(timestamp), turns = countif(name == "voice.turn") by id = tostring(customDimensions.interview_id)
| order by last_seen desc
| take 50
| project value = id, label = strcat(format_datetime(last_seen, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), "  ", substring(id, 0, 8), "  (", tostring(turns), " turns)"), selected = row_number() == 1

content.json:
## End to end for one interview

Pick the interview above (the newest is selected by default). The first table is its **full trace**: every telemetry item from the browser and the backend, in time order. Every browser call (REST and the voice WebSocket) with the backend work it caused: `network_ms` is browser time minus server time (distance + proxy), `breakdown` the backend's direct children (Azure OpenAI, SQL, judge, external brain). The `operation_Id` opens the whole trace in **Transaction search**.

content.title: Full trace of this interview: every item, browser and backend, in time order
content.query:
let iv = "{Interview}";
// The interview's operations: its browser voice events, its backend voice sessions, its REST calls.
let ops = union
    (customEvents | where tostring(customDimensions.interview_id) == iv | distinct operation_Id),
    (dependencies | where tostring(customDimensions["voice.interview_id"]) == iv | distinct operation_Id),
    (dependencies | where client_Type == "Browser" and name has iv | distinct operation_Id);
union requests, dependencies, customEvents, pageViews, traces, exceptions
| where isnotempty(iv) and operation_Id in (ops)
| where not(itemType == "dependency" and (name endswith " http send" or name endswith " http receive"))
| project timestamp, side = iff(client_Type == "Browser", "browser", "backend"), item = itemType, name = tostring(split(name, "?")[0]),
    duration_ms = round(duration), success, result = resultCode, detail = iff(itemType in ("trace", "exception"), coalesce(message, outerMessage), ""),
    id, parent_id = operation_ParentId, operation_Id
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: Request chain: browser call → backend → its children
Backend voice sessions of this interview (also those opened before the page's SDK was up)
content.query:
let iv = "{Interview}";
let errors = traces | where message == "voice.azure_error"
  | summarize azure_errors = count(), avatar_rate_limited = countif(tostring(customDimensions.avatar_rate_limited) =~ "true") by parent = operation_ParentId;
dependencies
| where isnotempty(iv) and name == "voice.session" and tostring(customDimensions["voice.interview_id"]) == iv
| join kind=leftouter errors on $left.id == $right.parent
| project timestamp, minutes = round(duration / 60000.0, 1), success, realtime = tostring(customDimensions["voice.realtime"]),
    mode = tostring(customDimensions["voice.mode"]), azure_errors, avatar_rate_limited, linked_to_browser = isnotempty(operation_ParentId), operation_Id
| order by timestamp asc

customEvents
| where name startswith "voice." and tostring(customDimensions.interview_id) == "{Interview}"
| extend d = customDimensions
| project timestamp, name, turn_kind = tostring(d.kind), outcome = tostring(d.outcome), mode = tostring(d.mode),
    turn = toint(customMeasurements.turn_index), click_to_audible_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms),
    total_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), first_audible_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.first_audible_ms),
    rtt_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.rtt_ms)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Voice events of this interview, in order

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.media" and tostring(customDimensions.interview_id) == "{Interview}"
| project timestamp, rtt_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.rtt_ms), audio_jitter_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.audio_jitter_ms), jitter_buffer_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.jitter_buffer_ms)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: WebRTC network over the session (RTT, jitter)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.media" and tostring(customDimensions.interview_id) == "{Interview}"
| project timestamp, audio_loss_pct = todouble(customMeasurements.audio_loss_pct), audio_concealed_pct = todouble(customMeasurements.audio_concealed_pct), video_loss_pct = todouble(customMeasurements.video_loss_pct)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: WebRTC loss over the session (%)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.media" and tostring(customDimensions.interview_id) == "{Interview}"
| project timestamp, video_fps = todouble(customMeasurements.video_fps), video_kbps = todouble(customMeasurements.video_kbps), audio_kbps = todouble(customMeasurements.audio_kbps), video_freezes = todouble(customMeasurements.video_freezes)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: WebRTC video over the session (fps, kbps, freezes)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.setup"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array m = customMeasurements
| extend metric = tostring(m[0]), value = todouble(m[1])
| where metric endswith "_ms"
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(value, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(value, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(value, 95)), max = round(max(value)) by metric
| extend step = array_index_of(dynamic(["ws_open_ms", "proxy_connected_ms", "session_updated_ms", "first_video_frame_ms", "media_ready_ms", "first_audible_ms"]), metric)
| order by step asc
| project-away step
content.title: Setup stages, from opening the WebSocket

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.setup"
| summarize n = count() by outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), avatar = tostring(customDimensions.avatar)
content.title: Setup outcomes

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.avatar"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array m = customMeasurements
| extend metric = tostring(m[0]), value = todouble(m[1])
| where metric endswith "_ms"
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(value, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(value, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(value, 95)), max = round(max(value)) by metric
| extend step = array_index_of(dynamic(["hold_ms", "create_offer_ms", "first_host_ms", "stun_srflx_ms", "turn_relay_ms", "ice_gather_ms", "sdp_answer_ms", "ice_connect_ms", "pc_connect_ms", "first_track_ms", "first_frame_ms", "total_ms", "total_audio_ms", "rtt_ms"]), metric)
| order by step asc
| project-away step
content.title: Handshake stages (ICE, STUN, TURN, SDP, first frame)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.avatar" and tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "frame"
| extend path = strcat(tostring(customDimensions.local_candidate), " / ", tostring(customDimensions.protocol), iff(isempty(tostring(customDimensions.relay_protocol)), "", strcat(" via ", tostring(customDimensions.relay_protocol))))
| summarize n = count(), p50_total_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), 50)), p95_total_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), 95)), p50_rtt_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.rtt_ms), 50)) by path
| order by n desc
content.title: Selected candidate path and its cost

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.avatar"
| summarize n = count() by label = tostring(customDimensions.label), outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| order by label asc, n desc
content.title: Handshake outcomes by kind

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.avatar" and tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "frame"
| summarize p50 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.total_ms), 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Avatar time to first frame over time (p50 / p95)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.kind) == "answer"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array m = customMeasurements
| extend metric = tostring(m[0]), value = todouble(m[1])
| where metric endswith "_ms"
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(value, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(value, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(value, 95)), max = round(max(value)) by metric
| extend step = array_index_of(dynamic(["speaking_ms", "stt_ms", "commit_wait_ms", "answer_http_ms", "answer_to_read_ms", "read_to_created_ms", "created_to_first_text_ms", "created_to_first_audio_delta_ms", "created_to_audible_ms", "response_ms", "click_to_audible_ms", "stop_to_audible_ms"]), metric)
| order by step asc
| project-away step
content.title: Answered-turn stages

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.kind) == "opening"
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array m = customMeasurements
| extend metric = tostring(m[0]), value = todouble(m[1])
| where metric endswith "_ms"
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(value, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(value, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(value, 95)), max = round(max(value)) by metric
| extend step = array_index_of(dynamic(["speaking_ms", "stt_ms", "commit_wait_ms", "answer_http_ms", "answer_to_read_ms", "read_to_created_ms", "created_to_first_text_ms", "created_to_first_audio_delta_ms", "created_to_audible_ms", "response_ms", "click_to_audible_ms", "stop_to_audible_ms"]), metric)
| order by step asc
| project-away step
content.title: Opening reads (question 1, no answer before it)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.kind) == "answer"
| summarize p50 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms), 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: What the candidate feels: answer finished → next question heard (p50 / p95)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.interview_id) == "{Interview}"
| project timestamp, turn = toint(customDimensions.turn_index), turn_kind = tostring(customDimensions.kind), heard = tostring(customDimensions.heard),
    stt_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.stt_ms), commit_wait_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.commit_wait_ms), answer_http_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.answer_http_ms),
    answer_to_read_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.answer_to_read_ms), read_to_created_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.read_to_created_ms),
    created_to_audible_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.created_to_audible_ms), click_to_audible_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms), response_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.response_ms)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Per-turn breakdown for the selected interview

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.kind) == "answer"
| summarize n = count(), p50_click_to_audible_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.click_to_audible_ms), 50)), p50_answer_http_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.answer_http_ms), 50)) by audio_path = tostring(customDimensions.audio_path), linear_turns = tostring(customDimensions.linear_turns)
content.title: Audio path and pipeline split

content.json:
## Backend (OpenTelemetry spans)

`answer_http_ms` above includes the brain/judge work below plus the network; the spans say which part it was.

content.query:
union dependencies, requests
| where name in ("voice.session", "judge.call", "external_brain.turn", "scoring.question")
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p90 = round(percentile(duration, 90)), p95 = round(percentile(duration, 95)), max = round(max(duration)), failed = countif(success == false) by name
content.title: Business spans

content.query:
requests
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95 = round(percentile(duration, 95)), failed = countif(success == false) by name
| where n >= 3
| top 15 by p95 desc
content.title: Slowest API routes (server side)

content.query:
dependencies
| where type !in ("InProc")
| summarize n = count(), p50 = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95 = round(percentile(duration, 95)), failed = countif(success == false) by type, target
| top 15 by n desc
content.title: Outbound calls (Azure OpenAI, external brain, storage, database)

content.query:
traces
| where message == "voice.azure_error"
| summarize n = count() by code = tostring(customDimensions.code), avatar_rate_limited = tostring(customDimensions.avatar_rate_limited), bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Voice Live errors from Azure (avatar rate limit included)

content.json:
## Voice WebSocket sessions

The browser records the voice socket as a `WebSocket` dependency (its duration is the session length) and passes its trace context when it opens it; the backend's `voice.session` span is its child. A socket opened before the SDK had loaded is recorded but not linked.

content.query:
let backend = dependencies | where name == "voice.session" | project s_parent = operation_ParentId, backend_s = duration / 1000.0, backend_ok = success;
dependencies
| where client_Type == "Browser" and type == "WebSocket"
| extend b_id = trim_end(@"\.", id)  // the SDK adds a trailing "." to the id we set
| join kind=leftouter backend on $left.b_id == $right.s_parent
| summarize sessions = count(), clean = countif(success == true), linked_to_backend = countif(isnotempty(s_parent)),
    p50_minutes = round(percentile(duration, 50) / 60000.0, 1), p95_minutes = round(percentile(duration, 95) / 60000.0, 1)
  by close_code = resultCode
| order by sessions desc
content.title: Sessions by close code

content.query:
let errors = traces | where message == "voice.azure_error"
  | summarize azure_errors = count(), avatar_rate_limited = countif(tostring(customDimensions.avatar_rate_limited) =~ "true") by parent = operation_ParentId;
dependencies
| where name == "voice.session"
| join kind=leftouter errors on $left.id == $right.parent
| summarize sessions = count(), failed = countif(success == false), with_azure_errors = countif(azure_errors > 0),
    avatar_rate_limited = sum(avatar_rate_limited), p50_minutes = round(percentile(duration, 50) / 60000.0, 1)
  by realtime = tostring(customDimensions["voice.realtime"]), mode = tostring(customDimensions["voice.mode"])
content.title: Backend voice sessions and the Azure errors in them

content.json:
## WebRTC media quality (`voice.media`)

The avatar's media goes browser ↔ Azure's TURN relay and never through our backend, so it is measured from the browser's `getStats()`: one sample per 15 s window while the call runs.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.media"
| summarize windows = count(),
    p50_rtt_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.rtt_ms), 50), 1), p95_rtt_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.rtt_ms), 95), 1),
    p50_audio_jitter_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.audio_jitter_ms), 50), 1), p95_audio_jitter_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.audio_jitter_ms), 95), 1),
    p50_jitter_buffer_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.jitter_buffer_ms), 50), 1), p95_jitter_buffer_ms = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.jitter_buffer_ms), 95), 1),
    p50_audio_loss_pct = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.audio_loss_pct), 50), 1), p95_audio_loss_pct = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.audio_loss_pct), 95), 1),
    p50_audio_concealed_pct = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.audio_concealed_pct), 50), 1), p95_audio_concealed_pct = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.audio_concealed_pct), 95), 1),
    p50_video_loss_pct = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.video_loss_pct), 50), 1), p95_video_loss_pct = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.video_loss_pct), 95), 1),
    p50_video_fps = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.video_fps), 50), 1), p95_video_fps = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.video_fps), 95), 1),
    p50_video_kbps = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.video_kbps), 50), 1), p95_video_kbps = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.video_kbps), 95), 1)
  by mode = tostring(customDimensions.mode)
content.title: Quality per media mode (p50 / p95)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.media" and tostring(customDimensions.mode) == "video"
| summarize freezes = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.video_freezes)), freeze_s = round(sum(todouble(customMeasurements.video_freeze_ms)) / 1000.0, 1),
    dropped_frames = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.video_frames_dropped)) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Freezes and dropped frames per hour

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.media"
| summarize p95_rtt_ms = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.rtt_ms), 95), p95_audio_loss_pct = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.audio_loss_pct), 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: RTT and loss over time (p95)

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.media" and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.resolution))
| summarize windows = count() by resolution = tostring(customDimensions.resolution)
content.title: Resolution received

content.json:
## Voice-only sessions (audio over the WebSocket)

Without an avatar the interviewer's audio arrives as PCM on the WebSocket and plays through the page's jitter buffer: a gap is the buffer running dry mid-speech.

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "voice.turn" and tostring(customDimensions.audio_path) == "ws"
| extend gaps = todouble(customMeasurements.playback_gaps), gap_ms = todouble(customMeasurements.playback_gap_ms_total)
| summarize turns = count(), turns_with_gaps = countif(gaps > 0), gaps = sum(gaps), avg_gap_ms = round(sum(gap_ms) / iff(sum(gaps) > 0, sum(gaps), 1.0))
content.title: Playback gaps per turn

content.json: ## Page load and API latency as the browser sees it

content.query:
browserTimings
| summarize loads = count(), p50_total_ms = round(percentile(totalDuration, 50)), p95_total_ms = round(percentile(totalDuration, 95)),
    p50_network_ms = round(percentile(networkDuration, 50)), p50_receive_ms = round(percentile(receiveDuration, 50)), p50_processing_ms = round(percentile(processingDuration, 50))
  by name
content.title: Page load (browser timings)

content.query:
let server = requests | project s_parent = operation_ParentId, server_ms = duration;
dependencies
| where client_Type == "Browser" and type != "WebSocket"
| extend route = replace_regex(tostring(split(name, "?")[0]), @"[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}", "{id}")
| extend b_id = trim_end(@"\.", id)
| join kind=leftouter server on $left.b_id == $right.s_parent
| summarize calls = count(), p50_browser_ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p50_server_ms = round(percentile(server_ms, 50)),
    p50_network_ms = round(percentile(duration - server_ms, 50)), p95_browser_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)), failed = countif(success == false)
  by route
| order by calls desc
content.title: API calls: browser time vs server time, per route

content.query:
dependencies
| where name == "scoring.question"
| summarize p50_s = percentile(duration, 50) / 1000.0, p95_s = percentile(duration, 95) / 1000.0 by bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Per-question scoring over time (p50 / p95)

content.query:
requests
| where name has "/report"
| summarize reports = count(), p50_s = round(percentile(duration, 50) / 1000.0, 1), p95_s = round(percentile(duration, 95) / 1000.0, 1), max_s = round(max(duration) / 1000.0, 1), failed = countif(success == false) by name
content.title: Whole reports (request time)

content.query:
dependencies
| where name == "judge.call"
| summarize calls = count(), p50_ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)), failed = countif(success == false)
  by verdict = tostring(customDimensions["judge.verdict"])
content.title: Judge verdicts and latency

content.query:
dependencies
| where name == "external_brain.turn"
| summarize turns = count(), p50_ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)), failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
content.title: External brain turns
